title: How To Add A Sidebar To Homepage
text:
## How To Add A Sidebar To Homepage
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000005307
Brilliant Directories offers a homepage sidebar that displays under the homepage image and divider:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12180359119/original/U07WOnCV8R-lTx0xUinlCDK0kmtwdPYyBA.png?1781316480 | alt: ]
Follow these instructions to add the homepage sidebar along with the recent articles widget:
1. Navigate to Settings » Design Settings » Homepage Layout » Homepage Section Order .
2. From the drop-down, select " Show Recent Member Articles with Sidebar " or " Show Recent Blog Articles with Sidebar ":
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12095916955/original/s-ne8eVDs4KhpVKPPtEzXOvICMAeK3YldQ.png?1627064145 | alt: ]
3. Click " Save Changes ".
4. Click " Edit Settings " for this section and select the desired sidebar from the available options:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12180359267/original/Rm38wOuJqvQ4OqvKyNFgkrGjc9QseXI4wA.png?1781316916 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12095916998/original/zZ2vqPSwzWSqWislzTQpB0XKMb2BuYKh6w.png?1627064258 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12095917013/original/sQ7qa3SlcoylczBUT-C0AGQpH4elpUSTUA.png?1627064287 | alt: ]
NOTE: If there are no published articles, the section will appear empty.
